handoff.summary: t-34ae.1 is done: 8 new Base64 tools and the 2 nav tweaks, committed locally on main in 14 commits (fcff279..dc82dc7, base a5c5db2). Not pushed. TOOLS (route → page, lib): 1. /base64/validate: Base64Validate.tsx, b64validate.ts. Validity, first invalid char (1-based code point, line:col, Select-it), variant (standard/url-safe/MIME/data URL+MIME), normalize (alphabet, padding, wrap 0/64/76), repairs with a Format/Repair/Data-loss list. 2. /base64/media: Base64Media.tsx, media-sniff.ts. Magic bytes for ~40 types. Preview only the sniffed type via revoked blob: URLs. SVG only as ; HTML/unknown download-only. PDF opt-in iframe. Mismatch warning against the declared data-URL type. Download with the right extension. 3. /base64/image: ImageToBase64.tsx, image-snippets.ts. Data URI, CSS, HTML (escaped alt + parsed width/height), Markdown, JSON, raw Base64. Original/encoded size and % overhead. 4. /base64/basic-auth: BasicAuth.tsx, basic-auth.ts. Build/decode, UTF-8 (ISO-8859-1 fallback), ':' in user warning, curl examples. 5. /base64/charset: Base64Charset.tsx, charset.ts. 16 charsets. Decode via TextDecoder; ISO-8859-1 is true Latin-1. Encoder uses reverse tables built lazily from TextDecoder (single-byte 0x00–FF; multi-byte lead/trail pairs, WHATWG encoder rules). Justification: correct by construction, no shipped tables (12.6 kB chunk), 7–13 ms first use. Unmappable chars: replace-with-? warning or error. Windows-1258 decomposes to base + combining mark on encode and is NFC on decode. Auto-detect: BOM → UTF-8 → UTF-16 → scored legacy guess, with an override. 6. /base64/compress: Base64Compress.tsx, compress.ts. gzip/zlib/raw deflate via CompressionStream; header auto-detect; sizes/ratio; 64 MB cap enforced between 32 KiB input slices. 7. /base64/base-n: BaseN.tsx, base-n.ts. Base32, base32hex, Base58 (Bitcoin), Ascii85, Z85, Base36 (one '0' per leading 0x00 byte, documented). Text or hex in and out, strict decoders. 8. /base64/mime: MimeUuencode.tsx, mime.ts + uuencode.ts. 76-col CRLF wrap/unwrap; uuencode/uudecode with begin/mode/filename, '`' zero, padding, length-char validation, safe download name. Nav: aria-label "Sidebar" → "Tool menu" (App.tsx); flyout bridge 16 → 12px (styles.css). Shared wiring: meta/icons/lazy registry entries; scripts/checks/base64-{a,b}.mjs hooks in browser-check; CSP gains media-src 'self' data: blob: (needed for audio/video blob previews). WHO DID WHAT - Lead (me): scaffold and nav commits fcff279 + 3b59218 (browser-check hook wiring, CSP media-src); merges; commit split. Fix-round edit: loosened the charset perf-test bound 250 → 1500 ms in charset.test.ts:91 (CI flake risk). Ran smoke/browser and reviewed the screenshots. - Peers: Codex was paused (usage limit until 05:35Z), so I switched to Claude per user preference. Group A = claude:opus worktree alp-child-fb121d64 (tools 1–4). Group B = claude:opus worktree alp-child-d3b6f701 (tools 5–8). Fix round = claude:opus in the shared checkout, alp-child-80c17c00. - Reviews: independent claude:fable (different model; Codex unavailable). Group A pass_with_findings (alp-child-a8984e41); group B pass_with_findings (alp-child-047ab7ab). No critical or high findings. All 6 medium and 7 of 8 low findings were fixed in 11e761b/dc82dc7. The PDF iframe sandbox was not applied, with evidence: Chrome blocks its PDF viewer in sandboxed frames. I ACCEPT all peer candidates after diff spot-checks plus full verification. - The fix-round commits were not independently re-reviewed (only my spot check plus tests, including fail-before checks by the peer). Main's new Codex usage rule (prefer above 50%, choose by fit at 10–50%, none at 10% or less) was noted; this task stayed on Claude because Codex was paused. TEST VECTORS: RFC 4648 §10 (base64/base32/base32hex); RFC 7617 (Aladdin:open sesame → QWxhZGRpbjpvcGVuIHNlc2FtZQ==, test:123£ → dGVzdDoxMjPCow==); Bitcoin Core base58_encode_decode.json; Wikipedia Ascii85 (Man → 9jqo^, Leviathan) cross-checked with CPython; ZeroMQ RFC 32 Z85 (864FD26FB559F75B → HelloWorld); Java Long.MAX_VALUE base36; Wikipedia uuencode (Cat → #0V%T) + CPython b2a_uu; WHATWG Encoding index bytes; Node zlib interop + `gzip -n` vector; PNG/JPEG/RIFF/ftyp/EBML/ID3/MPEG frame specs; WHATWG MIME Sniffing §6.

risks: PDF preview iframe is unsandboxed (Chrome refuses PDFs in sandboxed frames). Mitigations: shown only for bytes starting with %PDF-, Blob type fixed to application/pdf (browsers do not sniff blob: types), opt-in click. The reviewer found no same-origin script path. Alternatives if unwanted: open in a new tab, or no PDF preview
Fix-round commits 11e761b/dc82dc7 had no independent re-review (only lead spot check + full tests/browser). Main may want a second review, e.g. on Codex after 05:35Z if more than 50% usage remains

Charset auto-detect is heuristic (GBK vs Big5, UTF-16 without BOM only for Latin-script text); labelled low-confidence with an override. Node ICU euc-kr is narrower than Chrome's; the browser check covers Chrome
Base36 leading-zero convention ('0' per 0x00 byte) is a design choice, documented on the page
Uudecode decodes only the first begin..end block
The charset perf unit test has a 1500 ms bound (new code ~2 ms)
